contexts.text: He pursued them even to Hobah, which is on the left of Damascus () = extension so far... Damascus was the chief city of Syria (; ), and it has almost the same signification as Syria... The furthest boundary of Canaan, but beyond Dan, is described by Damascus (). The boundary of the Holy Land, or of the Lord's Kingdom, towards the north, is also called the boundary of Damascus (). AE 1088.
Eliezer of Damascus () = the external Church. Damascus was the chief city of Syria, where had been the remains of the Ancient Church...
Damascus was thy trader... ()... Damascus, being a city of Syria, = a concordant Scientific...
The Knowledges of truth and good destroyed... are here signified by Damascus (), which is treated of in this chapter.
On those who place religion in the knowledge of Knowledges only, which is Damascus.
. On those who pervert the Knowledges of truth, who are Damascus.
